biological_interpretation: The result is a narrow thalamic cytoskeletal-output hypothesis for KLF7 perturbation rather than full recovery of the developmental TrkA/CDKN/Rac3 program.
caveats: Klf7 mRNA was never FDR-significantly depleted, and only Tuba1a reached FDR < 0.05 among downstream rows.
This is the weakest retained story in the packet and should be treated as Support=3.
exact_observed_result: Klf7 perturbation generated one corrected hit in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Tuba1a down, with several additional projection/cytoskeletal genes including Coro1a, Sptan1, Stmn2, Map1b, Map6 and Dctn1 directionally lower at weaker significance; Ntrk1, Cdkn1a, Cdkn1b and Rac3 were not FDR-supported.

citations: Laub F, Aldabe R, Friedrich V, Ohnishi S, Yoshida T, Ramirez F. Developmental expression of mouse Krüppel-like transcription factor KLF7 suggests a potential role in neurogenesis. Developmental Biology. 2001;233(2):305-318.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior work supports the broad molecular function of the perturbed target or complex, while the atlas result refines the affected brain cell type and RNA-output module.

resolved_evidence.description: On-target Klf7 mRNA depletion was weak after multiple-testing correction across the assayed mouse-brain cell types.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Klf7 transcript rows were present in 22 Klf7 perturbation signatures; 16/22 logFC values were negative; median logFC -0.106; strongest decrease was in 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA with logFC -0.893, score -3.474, nominal p=5.12e-4, FDR=1.0; no Klf7 target-transcript row had FDR<0.1.

resolved_evidence.description: The thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class was the only Klf7 context with FDR-supported genes.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 200 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 17259 genes tested; 1 gene at FDR<0.05, 8 genes at FDR<0.1, and 20 genes at nominal p<0.001. Tuba1a score -4.958, logFC -0.281, p=7.11e-7, FDR=0.0123.

resolved_evidence.description: Klf7 effects were not broadly detected at corrected significance across the other assayed brain cell types.
resolved_evidence.statistics: The 21 non-151 Klf7 cell types had zero FDR<0.1 genes; their perturbation counts ranged from 26 to 165 cells and the best adjusted p value outside 151 was 0.1969 in 001 L5-6 IT Glut.

support.support_note: Exact log2 fold changes, p-values, and FDRs in exact_de_rows were re-read from the Wilcoxon Parquet for this grounding pass; score-vector correlations and perturbed/control cell counts are resolved from the structured report evidence.

title: Klf7 loss downshifts a thalamic neuronal-projection and cytoskeletal module
